name: flareyield-manager
description: FlareYield Manager — Root workspace runner for Frontend and Off-chain Executor Service

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix executor && npm install --prefix fce-extension && npm run build --prefix fce-extension
scripts.start: npx -y concurrently -n "FRONTEND,EXECUTOR,FCE-EXT,NGROK" -c "cyan,magenta,green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm start --prefix executor" "npm start --prefix fce-extension" "ngrok http 8080 --log=stdout"
